name: Nippon Chemi-Con Corporation
summary: Nippon Chemi-Con Corporation manufactures and sells capacitors, precision mechanical components and electronic equipment, with operations in Japan, China, the United States, Europe and elsewhere. Its main capacitors are aluminum electrolytic, conductive polymer solid and hybrid types, and the wider range adds ceramic and film capacitors, metal oxide varistors and nanocrystalline and amorphous materials.
